title: TopologyRelationshipAvailability
description: Scoped availability card for a callable topology relationship. It advertises a stable relationship id, optional semantic catalog backing, source/qualifier needs, and render modes without exposing topology-service view ids or graph internals.

relationshipId.description: Stable topology relationship id, for example topology.relationship.lag_membership.

status.description: Whether this relationship can currently be compiled for the scoped topology artifact.

catalogIds.description: Semantic catalog ids that define or help explain this relationship. Commit 1 keeps this optional so runtime descriptors can be added before reviewed Phase 6A catalog entries are enforced.

displayName.description: Short display label for prompt context and diagnostics.

description.description: Brief explanation of the relationship in the active topology context.

surface.description: Runtime surface where this relationship can be compiled.

requiredQualifiers.description: Qualifiers that may be required to compile this relationship.

supportedRenderModes.description: Render modes that topology-service can compile for this relationship in the current context.

defaultRenderMode.description: Preferred render mode when the caller does not specify one.

requiredGraphCapabilities.description: Stable capability names that must be present in the active graph for this relationship to compile. These are topology-service capability flags, not semantic catalog ids.

supportingGraphCapabilities.description: Optional graph capabilities that can improve this relationship but are not strictly required.

save.description: Save/template behavior for layers compiled from this relationship.

supported.description: Whether materialized layers from this relationship can be saved.

unavailableReason.description: Short reason when status is unavailable, degraded, needs_source, or needs_qualifier.
